title: When the Choir Turns
author: Ada Okonkwo
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
